Official docs cover endpoints, authentication, and versioning for WooCommerce 3.5+.

auth.details: Consumer key and secret generated in WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API; use HTTP Basic Auth over HTTPS (key as username, secret as password) or OAuth 1.0a on HTTP.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Included free with WooCommerce (open-source plugin); no per-request API fees from WooCommerce
pricing.paid_plans: WooCommerce core is free; hosting and optional WooCommerce.com extensions may be paid separately

apis.rate_limits: Not published by WooCommerce; limited by the WordPress/host server configuration
use_cases: list or create WooCommerce products for a store
fetch and update orders and order status
manage customers and customer data
create coupons and apply discount rules
pull sales reports and store analytics
sync inventory stock levels across systems

apis.name: Wordnik

Developers can look up words, explore word relationships, and power dictionary-style features. Authentication is typically via API key; free-tier limits and rate limits should be verified from the current official docs and pricing page before production use.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter (self-serve signup on developer portal).

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown

apis.rate_limits: not published

example.response_snippet: [{"text":"a thing characteristic of its kind or illustrating a general rule","partOfSpeech":"noun","sourceDictionary":"..."}]

use_cases: look up definitions for an English word
fetch example sentences for a word
get related words (synonyms, antonyms)
retrieve word pronunciations or audio

apis.name: WordsAPI
apis.tagline: Word definitions, synonyms, rhymes, and frequency data for English vocabulary.
apis.description: WordsAPI provides dictionary and lexical data for English words including definitions, synonyms, antonyms, rhymes, pronunciation, frequency, and related word forms via a REST API. It is commonly used for language tools, education apps, word games, and NLP features that need structured lexical lookup rather than full NLP pipelines.

auth.details: API key via RapidAPI headers (X-RapidAPI-Key and X-RapidAPI-Host); self-serve signup on RapidAPI.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 2,500 requests/day on RapidAPI BASIC free plan (soft limit; overage $0.004/request)
pricing.paid_plans: Paid tiers via RapidAPI; exact limits not verified in this pass

apis.rate_limits: BASIC free: 2,500/day soft (+$0.004 overage); Pro: 25,000/day soft; Ultra: 250,000/day soft; Mega: 500,000/day soft (RapidAPI daily quotas)
use_cases: look up definitions and part of speech for a word
get synonyms or antonyms for thesaurus features
find rhyming words for poetry or games
retrieve word frequency or pronunciation data

apis.name: WorkOS
apis.tagline: Enterprise SSO, SCIM directory sync, and admin portal APIs for B2B apps.
apis.description: WorkOS provides developer-friendly APIs for enterprise-ready authentication and user management features. Core products include Single Sign-On (SAML/OIDC), Directory Sync (SCIM), Admin Portal, Magic Auth, AuthKit, Audit Logs, and more — designed so B2B SaaS apps can offer enterprise identity features without building them from scratch.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header (sk_test_* or sk_live_* from Dashboard). Self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: AuthKit/User Management: first 1M MAUs free (then $2,500/mo per additional 1M MAUs). Radar: first 1,000 checks free. Staging free. SSO & Directory Sync paid per connection from #1 (no free connections).

apis.rate_limits: Published: general 6,000 req/60s per API key; AuthKit reads 1,000/10s and writes 500/10s on /user_management/*; plus endpoint-specific limits (SSO authorize 1,000/60s per connection, directory users 4/s per directory).
use_cases: add SAML/OIDC enterprise SSO to a B2B SaaS app
sync users and groups from customer IdPs via SCIM directory sync
embed an admin portal so customers self-configure SSO
implement passwordless magic link or AuthKit authentication
emit and query enterprise audit logs for compliance

apis.name: World News API
apis.tagline: Global news search and extraction API with geo and sentiment filters.
apis.description: World News API provides search and retrieval of news articles from sources worldwide, with filters for location, language, sentiment, and entities. It offers search, top headlines, and extract endpoints for building news apps, media monitoring, and research tools.

auth.details: API key via api-key query parameter or header (self-serve signup).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free: 50 points/day (then no more calls until midnight UTC reset); 1-month history; backlink required. Points ≠ 1:1 requests (typical call costs ~1 point + 0.01/result).

apis.rate_limits: Published by plan. Free: 60 req/min, 1 concurrent; Reporter: 2 req/s, 5 concurrent; Journalist: 10 req/s, 10 concurrent; Editor: 20 req/s, 10 concurrent. Daily point quotas on pricing.

apis.name: WorldTimeAPI
apis.tagline: Free public timezone and current time API by IANA zone or IP
apis.description: WorldTimeAPI is a free public REST service that returns the current local time, UTC offset, DST status, and related timezone metadata for any IANA timezone, for a client IP address, or for a given IP. Responses are JSON (or plain text). No API key is required. The project is community-maintained; capacity and uptime can vary, and heavy automated use is discouraged.

auth.details: No authentication. Public HTTP GET endpoints; no API key or signup required.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Entirely free; no published free-tier quota or paid plans

apis.rate_limits: not published (community reports of intermittent rate limiting / capacity issues; heavy automated use discouraged)
use_cases: get current local time for an IANA timezone
list all available IANA timezone identifiers
resolve client or arbitrary IP address to local time and timezone
check DST status and UTC offset for a region
convert between unixtime and timezone-local datetime metadata

apis.name: X API
apis.tagline: Official X (Twitter) platform API for posts, users, search, and engagement.
apis.description: X API (formerly Twitter API) provides programmatic access to posts, user profiles, timelines, search, direct messages, media, and engagement data on X. Developers authenticate with OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens, call REST endpoints under api.x.com, and choose Free, Basic, Pro, or Enterprise tiers depending on volume and features.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 (user context) or OAuth 2.0 App-Only Bearer Token; also OAuth 1.0a. Create a Project/App in the X Developer Portal; use Authorization: Bearer YOUR_BEARER_TOKEN or OAuth signed requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier exists with very low write/read caps (e.g. limited posts/month and read requests); exact published numbers change — verify on developer.x.com pricing. Pay-as-you-go Basic/Pro for higher volume.
pricing.paid_plans: Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers via developer.x.com; pricing and included request quotas vary by product (posts, search, etc.).

apis.rate_limits: Per-endpoint and per-app/user limits vary by product tier; published in X API rate-limit docs (e.g. many v2 read endpoints ~15–900 req/15 min depending on endpoint and auth).
use_cases: fetch a user profile by username
post a tweet/status on behalf of a user
search recent public posts by keyword
get a user’s recent timeline posts
lookup engagement metrics for a post
stream or poll mentions of a brand account
